files.code:
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import tempfile
import time

import libtmux

directory = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="libtmux-py-home-"))
socket = directory / "tmux.sock"
server = libtmux.Server(socket_path=socket, config_file="/dev/null")

try:
    session = server.new_session(session_name="demo")
    window = session.active_window
    assert window is not None
    pane = window.split(shell="sh")

    pane.send_keys("printf '\\nHello world\\n'", enter=True)

    deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
    while "Hello world" not in pane.capture_pane():
        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            raise TimeoutError("The pane did not print Hello world")
        time.sleep(0.02)

    print("Hello world")
except Exception as error:
    raise RuntimeError("tmux quickstart failed") from error
finally:
    if socket.exists():
        server.kill()
    shutil.rmtree(directory)

files.code:
require "libtmux"

server = LibTmux::Server.start

begin
  session = server.new_session(
    name: "work",
    window_name: "main",
    command: ["/bin/cat"]
  )

  window = session.new_window(name: "logs", command: ["/bin/cat"])
  window.split(
    direction: :horizontal,
    size: "40%",
    command: ["/bin/cat"]
  )

  snapshot = server.snapshot
  snapshot.windows.each do |window|
    pane_ids = window.panes.map(&:id).join(", ")
    puts "#{window.name}: #{pane_ids}"
  end
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "tmux quickstart failed: #{error.message}"
  raise
ensure
  server.close
end

local adapter = require("libtmux.runtime.luv")
local uv = require("luv")

local function must(value, err)
    if err ~= nil then error(err, 0) end
    return value
end

local binary
for directory in (os.getenv("PATH") or ""):gmatch("[^:]+") do
    local candidate = uv.fs_realpath(directory .. "/tmux")
    if candidate and uv.fs_access(candidate, "X") then
        binary = candidate
        break
    end
end
assert(binary, "tmux must be installed on PATH")

local directory = assert(uv.fs_mkdtemp("/tmp/ltx-lua-home-XXXXXX"))
local socket = directory .. "/tmux.sock"

local function tmux(arguments)
    local args = { "-S", socket }
    for _, argument in ipairs(arguments) do
        args[#args + 1] = argument
    end

    local timer = assert(uv.new_timer())
    local process, status
    process = assert(uv.spawn(binary, {
        args = args,
        stdio = { nil, 1, 2 },
    }, function(code)
        status = code
        process:close()
        timer:stop()
        timer:close()
    end))
    timer:start(10000, 0, function()
        process:kill("sigkill")
    end)
    uv.run()
    assert(status == 0, "tmux command failed or timed out")
end

local ok, failure = xpcall(function()
    -- This Lua API connects to an existing daemon. Start our own first.
    tmux({
        "-f", "/dev/null", "new-session", "-d",
        "-s", "work", "-n", "main", "/bin/sh",
    })

    must(adapter.run(function(runtime)
        local server = must(runtime:connect({
            binary = binary,
            socket_path = socket,
        }):await())

        local created = must(server:new_session({
            name = "quickstart",
            window_name = "main",
            argv = { "/bin/sh" },
        }):await())

        local logs = must(created.session:new_window({
            name = "logs",
            argv = { "/bin/cat" },
        }):await())
        must(logs.pane:split({
            direction = "right",
            percent = 40,
            argv = { "/bin/cat" },
        }):await())

        local marker = "libtmux-ready"
        local quoted = "'" .. binary:gsub("'", "'\\''") .. "'"
        local command = ("printf '\\nlibtmux ready\\n'; "
            .. "%s wait-for -S %s"):format(quoted, marker)
        must(created.pane:send_text(command):await())
        must(created.pane:send_keys({ "Enter" }):await())
        must(server:command(
            { "wait-for", marker },
            { timeout = 10000 }
        ):await())

        local capture = must(created.pane:capture():await())
        assert(must(capture:text()):find(
            "\nlibtmux ready\n", 1, true
        ), "pane output was not captured")
        print("libtmux ready")

        must(server:close():await())
        return true
    end))
end, debug.traceback)

local cleaned, cleanup_error = pcall(function()
    if uv.fs_stat(socket) then tmux({ "kill-server" }) end
    local removed, _, code = uv.fs_unlink(socket)
    assert(removed or code == "ENOENT", "could not remove owned socket")
    assert(uv.fs_rmdir(directory))
end)

if not cleaned then io.stderr:write(tostring(cleanup_error), "\n") end
if not ok then error(failure, 0) end
assert(cleaned, "cleanup failed; retained " .. directory)

files.code:
import io.github.libtmux.ServerConfig
import io.github.libtmux.ServerEndpoint
import io.github.libtmux.TextOutcome
import io.github.libtmux.kotlin.*
import java.nio.file.Path
import java.time.Duration
import java.util.UUID
import kotlinx.coroutines.NonCancellable
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlin.time.Duration.Companion.seconds

fun main() = runBlocking {
    val socket = "libtmux-home-${UUID.randomUUID()}"
    val config = ServerConfig.builder()
        .endpoint(ServerEndpoint.namedSocket(socket))
        .configFile(Path.of("/dev/null"))
        .defaultTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(5))
        .build()

    withServer(config) { server ->
        try {
            val session = server.newSession("work")
            val pane = session.activeWindow?.activePane
                ?: error("no active pane")

            pane.sendLine("printf '\\nrea%s\\n' dy")
            val outcome = pane.awaitText("ready", timeout = 5.seconds)
            check(outcome != TextOutcome.TIMED_OUT)

            val lines = pane.capture()
            check(lines.any { it.trim() == "ready" })

            val run = pane.run("echo hi && exit 3", timeout = 5.seconds)
            check(run.exitStatus.orNull() == 3)

            println("ready; exit ${run.exitStatus.orNull()}")
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            throw IllegalStateException(
                "tmux quickstart failed", error
            )
        } finally {
            withContext(NonCancellable) {
                server.killServer()
            }
        }
    }
}

import io.github.libtmux.{ServerConfig, ServerEndpoint}
import io.github.libtmux.scaladsl.{config => _, *}
import java.nio.file.Path
import java.time.Duration
import java.util.UUID
import scala.util.Using

object Main {
  def main(args: Array[String]): Unit = {
    val socket = s"libtmux-home-${UUID.randomUUID()}"
    val config = ServerConfig.builder()
      .endpoint(ServerEndpoint.namedSocket(socket))
      .configFile(Path.of("/dev/null"))
      .defaultTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(5))
      .build()

    Using.resource(Server.open(config)) { server =>
      val session = server.newSession("work")
      session.newWindow("logs")

      val panes = server.panes()
      val named = panes.filter(_.info.title().nonEmpty)
      val commands = named.map(_.info.currentCommand())
      assert(panes.size == 2)

      println(s"${session.name}: ${panes.size} panes")
      println(s"commands: ${commands.distinct.sorted.mkString(", ")}")
    }
  }
}

files.name: app/Program.fs
files.code:
open System
open System.Threading
open LibTmux
open LibTmux.FSharp

let runAsync () =
    task {
        use deadline = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds 30.)
        let token = deadline.Token

        let options =
            ServerConnectionOptions(
                SocketName = "fsharp-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"),
                ConfigurationFile = "/dev/null",
                TmuxBinaryPath =
                    (Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable "LIBTMUX_TMUX"
                     |> Option.ofObj
                     |> Option.defaultValue "tmux")
            )

        use! owned = LibTmux.Server.CreateOwnedAsync(options, token)

        for name in [ "build"; "web"; "worker" ] do
            let! _ =
                owned.Value.CreateSessionAsync(
                    NewSessionRequest(Name = name, Command = "/bin/sh"),
                    token
                )

            ()

        let! server = LibTmux.Server.ConnectAsync(options, token)

        // List and filter: tmux narrows the listing; every row is rechecked.
        // atMostOne is None when nothing matches and raises when several do.
        let! build =
            server
            |> Server.sessions
            |> Query.where (SessionFields.name |> Filter.eq "build")
            |> Query.atMostOne token

        let! others =
            server
            |> Server.sessions
            |> Query.where (SessionFields.name |> Filter.ne "build")
